title.purpose: Native system sans for the compact menu panel heading.

metric.purpose: Rounded system figures with monospaced digits for values that change.

shadows.name: menu-panel-shadow
shadows.purpose: Separate the single HUD panel from the desktop without lifting each data row.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Communicate state changes only; avoid decorative motion.

components.name: Menu Panel
components.description: One adaptive macOS-style glass surface around the compact usage panel.
components.css: .ds-menu-panel { color-scheme: light dark; color: CanvasText; background: color-mix(in srgb, Canvas 86%, transparent); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(130%); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(130%); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 12%, transparent); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 16%, transparent); padding: 12px; font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-menu-panel-content { min-width: 0; }

components.name: Provider Row
components.description: Flat, compact row with a provider label, explicit status, and trailing metric.
components.html: GLMZ.ai GLMResets today · 3% left97%
components.css: .ds-provider-row { color-scheme: light dark; color: CanvasText; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 12%, transparent); font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-provider-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-provider-icon { color: GrayText; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-provider-copy { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-provider-copy strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-provider-copy small { color: GrayText; font-size: 11px; } .ds-provider-metric { font: 700 17px ui-rounded, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Quota Meter
components.description: A thin meter that reinforces, but never replaces, the displayed percentage and reset text.
components.css: .ds-quota-meter { height: 4px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 14%, transparent); } .ds-quota-meter span { display: block; width: var(--ds-quota-value); height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: AccentColor; } .ds-quota-meter[data-critical="true"] span { background: Mark; }

components.name: Connection Status
components.description: Neutral when setup is missing; failures use a warning icon and readable text.
components.html: Not connected
components.css: .ds-connection-status { color: GrayText; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-connection-status svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-connection-status[data-error="true"] { color: Mark; }

components.name: Quick Add Button
components.description: Small native-feeling action for adding a named plan preset without guessing its price or renewal date.
components.css: .ds-quick-add { color: AccentColor; background: color-mix(in srgb, AccentColor 10%, Canvas); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, AccentColor 24%, transparent); border-radius: 7px; min-height: 28px; padding: 6px 8px; font: 600 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-quick-add:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, AccentColor 16%, Canvas); } .ds-quick-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-quick-add:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, AccentColor 22%, Canvas); }

narrative.overview:
AI Subs is a personal macOS utility for checking subscription renewals, API spend, and coding-plan quota without leaving the current task. Its visual language should feel like a native menu-bar extra: compact, calm, and immediately legible. Keep one translucent HUD-like panel as the frame; inside it, prefer dense, table-like provider rows over a stack of repeated cards.

The palette and controls adapt to macOS appearance and accent settings. A number must always say what it measures: recurring plan cost, month-to-date API spend, or a provider's own quota cycle. Missing setup is a neutral state; warnings are reserved for real failures or actionable thresholds. This system rejects false alarms, repeated decorative cards, and color-only status.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, technical information hierarchy with familiar macOS controls.
Adaptive HUD vibrancy around flat, scan-friendly rows.
Explicit labels and text/icon state cues; semantic colors reinforce rather than replace meaning.
Distinct treatment for subscription totals, API spend, and plan quota.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Missing credentials are neutral. Orange means a recoverable error; red means a high-severity threshold. Always pair color with readable text or an icon.

rules.name: The Adaptive Palette Rule
rules.body: Do not replace system appearance/accent colors with fixed dark-mode hex values. Let macOS choose the light/dark surface and user accent.

rules.name: The Scan-First Type Rule
rules.body: One glance should distinguish the number from its unit and period. Use monospaced digits for changing values and keep the label adjacent.

rules.name: The One-Glass-Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep vibrancy on the outer panel. Rows and progress indicators stay legible, compact, and mostly flat.

dos: Do label values as `plans / month`, `API spend / MTD`, or `quota used / reset`.
Do show a neutral “Not connected” state until a provider has credentials; reserve warnings for actual errors.
Do pair every semantic color with a label or icon.
Do use one glass panel, compact rows, system appearance, and native controls.
Do make quota thresholds actionable and announce them once when crossed.
Do keep preset price and renewal fields editable and user-confirmed.
donts: Don't show a warning-colored error for a provider that is merely not configured.
Don't use oversized dashboards or repeated cards that make a menu-bar utility slow to scan.
Don't communicate status by color alone.
Don't combine recurring subscription cost, API spend, and plan-cycle quota into one ambiguous total.
Don't hard-code a dark palette or use repeated blur/shadow layers.
